quotes.name: Steamflogger Service Rep
quotes.flavor: It's more like a hard day of lunch with a work break between shifts.

quotes.name: Raise the Past
quotes.flavor: Conyan the Great carefully selected his last words as he lay bleeding on the battlefield. Moments later, he snapped awake in a body of stone, with a startled, curious face peering at him.

quotes.name: Ezuri's Predation
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: "Those who do not submit will be consumed."

quotes.name: Demonic Taskmaster
quotes.flavor: Subservience to greater power is the only law in the pit.

quotes.name: Swords to Plowshares
quotes.flavor:
"So that's what it means to be a Doctor of War."
—The First Doctor

quotes.name: Wash Away
quotes.flavor:
"May the ocean take it"
—Nephalia expression meaning
"good riddance"

quotes.name: Sengir Vampire
quotes.flavor: Empires rise and fall, but evil is eternal.

quotes.name: Azorius Knight-Arbiter
quotes.flavor: Thanks to the magic in his Writ of Passage, alms beasts lumbered aside, anarchs bowed their heads, and even Rakdos acrobats rolled their spikewheels out of his way.

quotes.name: Farhaven Elf
quotes.flavor: "Verdant bloom does exist. It merely hides for its own safety."

quotes.name: Selfless Cathar
quotes.flavor: "If I fail to offer myself, we will surely be overrun. My fate would be the same."

quotes.name: Sunbond
quotes.flavor:
"I was not chosen for my faith in the gods. Sometimes the gods must put their faith in us."
—Elspeth

quotes.name: Fact or Fiction
quotes.flavor: "Try to pretend like you understand what's important."

quotes.name: Virulent Plague
quotes.flavor:
"This pestilence robs us of glorious death in battle. We starve to death with full bellies and drown trying to slake our unnatural thirst."
—Kerai Hatesinger, Kolaghan warrior

quotes.name: Balmor, Battlemage Captain
quotes.flavor: "Even the most hardened armies are ill-equipped to defend against an onslaught from the sky."

quotes.name: Kin-Tree Warden
quotes.flavor: "The amber of the tree and the blood of my veins are the same."

quotes.name: Heap Doll
quotes.flavor:
"I know one night it won't come back. Then I'll know it's truly done its job."
—Braenna, cobblesmith

quotes.name: Nausea
quotes.flavor: No fear. No sense. And soon, no lunch.

quotes.name: Hinterland Harbor
quotes.flavor:
"Our ancestors brought down a Phyrexian portal ship, then built our town on its hull. We're pretty proud of that."
—Alene of Riverspan

quotes.name: Vraan, Executioner Thane
quotes.flavor: Do not fear death. Fear failure.

quotes.name: Supply Caravan
quotes.flavor:
"We each have a weight to carry on the road to the afterlife."
—Oketra, god of solidarity

quotes.name: Felidar Sovereign
quotes.flavor: It surveys the withering landscape, waiting for a victory only it can see.

quotes.name: Stand Together
quotes.flavor: Strange times make for strange allies.

quotes.name: Evacuation
quotes.flavor: Which is more unsettling: the roar of battle or the silence that follows?

quotes.name: Grim Haruspex
quotes.flavor: "We all want to know what's going on in someone else's head. I simply open it up and look."

quotes.name: Flooded Strand
quotes.flavor: Where dragons once slept, their bones now rest.

quotes.name: Leonin Skyhunter
quotes.flavor: The skyhunters were born when the first leonin gazed at the heavens and wished to hunt the birds overhead.

quotes.name: Blind Obedience
quotes.flavor: "By the time your knees have worn through your robe, you may have begun to learn your place."

quotes.name: Pearled Unicorn
quotes.flavor:
"'Do you know, I always thought Unicorns were fabulous monsters, too? I never saw one alive before!'
'Well, now that we *have* seen each other,' said the Unicorn, 'if you'll believe in me, I'll believe in you.'" —Lewis Carroll, *Through the Looking-Glass*

quotes.name: Goblin Glider
quotes.flavor:
"What's got two arms, one wing, and no brains?"
—Ghitu riddle

quotes.name: Homing Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"Where did *you* come from?"
—Otarian hunter, last words

quotes.name: Pulse of Murasa
quotes.flavor: "Little flower twirl and bloom, arise from this your rocky tomb. Little warrior slash and brawl, be born again to free us all."

quotes.name: Yargle, Glutton of Urborg
quotes.flavor: When Belzenlok's lieutenant Yar-Kul grew too ambitious, the Demonlord transformed him into a maggot. The frog that ate the maggot grew and grew, until a ravenous spirit burst from its body.

quotes.name: Counterspell
quotes.flavor:
"Your attack has been rendered harmless. It is, however, quite pretty."
—Saprazzan vizier

quotes.name: Ward of Piety
quotes.flavor: Reluctant to strike at the kami directly, some kitsune trained in more passive fighting techniques.

quotes.name: Ambush Party
quotes.flavor:
"Call it a cost of doing business. The best way to protect against thieves is to hire better thieves."
—Eron the Relentless

quotes.name: Marcus, Mutant Mayor
quotes.flavor: "Welcome to Jacobstown, human. You're free to walk around. Just don't stare at the nightkin."

quotes.name: Hibernation
quotes.flavor: The deep sleep of winter is not always restful.

quotes.name: Food Chain
quotes.flavor: Every pizza is some teenager's prey.

quotes.name: Mysterio, Master of Illusion
quotes.flavor: A skilled showman, Quentin Beck incorporated lights, special effects, holography . . . all in the service of a . . . DRAMATIC . . . ENTRANCE!

quotes.name: Zhentarim Bandit
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor:
"The Zhentarim are ruthless, unscrupulous, and dishonest. But I must admit, they are effective."
—Commander Liara Portyr

quotes.name: Sunhome, Fortress of the Legion
quotes.flavor: Sunhome—the stalwart shield, the towering sentinel, the seat of justice.

quotes.name: Island
quotes.flavor: Alarmed by the news you brought, the storm giant king of the Maelstrom has called his kin to council.

quotes.name: Cadaver Imp
quotes.flavor: The mouth must be pried open before rigor mortis sets in. Otherwise the returning soul can find no ingress.

quotes.name: Villainous Wealth
quotes.flavor: Gold buys death. Death earns gold.

quotes.name: People of the Woods
quotes.flavor:
"Their rain of arrows left only myself alive, cowering within a tree hollow. They did not even come out to loot the bodies."
—Vervamon the Elder

quotes.name: Adventurer's Inn
quotes.flavor:
"Welcome! We have rooms for 200 gil a night. Would you like to stay and rest your body and mind?"
—Innkeep

quotes.name: Colorless Ultimatum
quotes.flavor: Designed by players at MagicCon: Atlanta 2025.

quotes.name: Boggart Brute
quotes.flavor: He has the biggest bashing stick, so it's a safe bet he's the leader.

quotes.name: Bountiful Harvest
quotes.flavor:
"When we fail to see the beauty in every tree, we are no better than humans."
—Saelia, elvish scout

quotes.name: Venser, Shaper Savant
quotes.flavor: His marvels of artifice pale in comparison to the developing machinery of his mind.

quotes.name: Kindred Discovery
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor: Few things are truly "lost" at sea.

quotes.name: Circle of Flame
quotes.flavor:
"Which do you think is a better deterrent: a moat of water or one of fire?"
—Chandra Nalaar

quotes.name: Scornful Aether-Lich
quotes.flavor:
"With no flesh, there is no pain, no hesitation, no emotion of any kind. He is crafted perfection."
—Tezzeret

quotes.name: Koth of the Homestead
quotes.flavor: "Malach, tell your mother the steelfruit harvest is abundant this cycle!"

quotes.name: Patron of the Valiant
quotes.flavor: "Bant's most gallant knights wear my sigil, and for that I am humbled."

quotes.name: Neheb, the Eternal
quotes.flavor: "Live an exemplary life. Die a worthy death. Rise in eternal glory."

quotes.name: Loyal Warhound
quotes.set_name: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms Promos
quotes.flavor: A paladin's steed is a celestial spirit in animal form.

quotes.name: Last One Standing
quotes.flavor: Some train all their lives for a shot at the title. Some just get really, really lucky.

quotes.name: Tapestry of the Ages
quotes.flavor:
"Abzan, Jeskai, Sultai, Mardu, Temur—names lost to history, yet worthy of further study."
—Narset

quotes.name: Glint Hawk
quotes.flavor: Its eyes burned nearly blind by the Whitesun, it hunts by metallic gleam.

quotes.name: Archon of the Wild Rose
quotes.flavor: The curse of Redtooth Keep could only be broken by a mystical rose that blooms in moonlight.

quotes.name: Druid's Call
quotes.flavor: Suffer the little creatures, for they may yet rise up and beat you senseless.

quotes.name: Void Mirror
quotes.flavor:
"A mirror does more than reflect reality—it shapes it."
—Niko Aris

quotes.name: Brash Taunter
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: "You hit like a kobold!"

quotes.name: Shrapnel Blast
quotes.flavor: From trinket to trauma.

quotes.name: Molimo, Maro-Sorcerer
quotes.flavor: "My mind is the spread of the canopy. My heart is the embrace of the roots. I am deathless Llanowar, its fury and its peace."

quotes.name: Banshee
quotes.flavor: Some say Banshees are the hounds of Death, baying to herd their prey into the arms of their master.

quotes.name: Royal Herbalist
quotes.flavor:
"Just as an Herbalist heals a wound, so must we heal the rift between Balduvia and Kjeldor."
—King Darien of Kjeldor

quotes.name: Stone Quarry
quotes.flavor: Marble was the lifeblood of the Greek economy. By controlling the supply, the Cult of Kosmos controlled Greece.

quotes.name: Brambleweft Behemoth
quotes.flavor: Life will find a way, or it will make one.

quotes.name: Predation Steward
quotes.flavor:
"Best we move on. That gurgling means it's feeding time."
—Melira

quotes.name: Voyager Glidecar
quotes.flavor: "Exclamatory: Hang on to something."

quotes.name: Springmane Cervin
quotes.flavor: Cervins feed on the mana-rich plants around the star arches, imbuing their bodies with extraordinary grace and vitality.

quotes.name: Network Terminal
quotes.flavor: Public access terminals around Towashi provide residents with up-to-date information on everything from traffic delays to hostile kami sightings.

quotes.name: Magus of the Coffers
quotes.flavor: All that remains of the Cabal are the echoes in its deepest vault. Yet those who hear the echoes feel a power undiminished by the dust of ages.

quotes.name: Overwhelm
quotes.flavor: The Conclave acts with a single will, expressed by countless warriors.

quotes.name: Rise from the Grave
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Garruk vs. Liliana
quotes.flavor:
"Death is no excuse for disobedience."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Wind Dancer
quotes.flavor: "Take my hand and dance to the music of the winds."

quotes.name: Rally of Wings
quotes.flavor: Even the clouds became a field of battle. Known as the Sky Theater, it saw the Eternals clash with squadrons of angels.

quotes.name: Laid to Rest
quotes.flavor:
"We are not here to mourn their loss. We are here to celebrate their lives."
—Vesna, Dawnhart witch

quotes.name: Ishgard, the Holy See // Faith & Grief
quotes.flavor: A great and proud nation devoted to Halone, the Fury.

quotes.name: Battering Sliver
quotes.flavor: Covered with hard shell-like plates, these slivers burrow through solid rock to carve out new nests for their hives.

quotes.name: Olog-hai Crusher
quotes.flavor: Trolls were abroad, no longer dull-witted, but cunning and armed with dreadful weapons.

quotes.name: Thorn Thallid
quotes.flavor:
"The danger in cultivating massive plants caught the Elves by surprise."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. III*

quotes.name: Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements
quotes.flavor: When the world needed him most, the Avatar returned.

quotes.name: Circle of Dreams Druid
quotes.set_name: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms Promos
quotes.flavor: The realms protected by druids of the Circle of Dreams are gleaming, fruitful places, where dream and reality blur together and the weary can find rest.

quotes.name: Munitions Enthusiast
quotes.flavor:
"What is the point of your spikes?" asked the *boqrat*. "You cannot attack with them."
"Perhaps not," laughed the *targ*. "But they bring me great joy!"

quotes.name: Doctor Octopus, Master Planner
quotes.flavor: "Soon all will cower before the superior intellect of Doctor Octopus!"

quotes.name: Desperate Charge
quotes.flavor: "Lieutenants dishonored, corpses carted home; The general raises troops again to take revenge."

quotes.name: Ghoulraiser
quotes.flavor:
"Come. Bring your brothers. Tonight, you feast on living flesh."
—Jadar, ghoulcaller of Nephalia

quotes.name: Harvesttide Infiltrator // Harvesttide Assailant
quotes.flavor: He was one masked stranger among many. Blending in was child's play.

quotes.name: Furygale Flocking
quotes.flavor: Seek inspiration at your own risk.

quotes.name: Embereth Shieldbreaker // Battle Display
quotes.flavor: "Courage is the only shield I need."

quotes.name: Sunblast Angel
quotes.flavor: There may exist powers even greater than Phyrexia.

quotes.name: Hand of Silumgar
quotes.flavor: Silumgar trains those whom he favors in his magic, granting them the ability to spread his disdain across the land.

quotes.name: Veteran Bodyguard
quotes.flavor: Good bodyguards are hard to find, mainly because they don't live long.

quotes.name: Anger
quotes.flavor:
"Molten earth has no anger of its own. Only by infusing it with your own rage can the magma seethe and take shape."
—Koth of the Hammer

quotes.name: Disciple of Perdition
quotes.flavor: "Could you please spare some of your blood for my precious little tree?"

quotes.name: Maro
quotes.flavor: No two see the same Maro.

quotes.name: Burst of Energy
quotes.flavor:
"I stand ready to die for our world. Who will stand with me?"
—Radiant, archangel

quotes.name: Hanweir Watchkeep // Bane of Hanweir
quotes.flavor: He scans for wolves, knowing there's one he can never anticipate.

quotes.name: Icy Manipulator
quotes.flavor:
"The scavengers who first found it called it the 'Bone Crank.' Not a bad name, I'd say."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

quotes.name: Scroll Thief
quotes.flavor: Kapsho merfolk have infiltrated fortresses as remote as the desert citadel in Sunari in their relentless quest for arcane knowledge.

quotes.name: Feather of Flight
quotes.flavor: As he grasped the glowing feather, the lizard's heart soared, and the rest of him quickly followed.

quotes.name: Atog
quotes.flavor: The bane of all artificers, the legendary Atogs devoured intricate tools to further their own twisted growth.

quotes.name: Hellfire Mongrel
quotes.flavor: There is no fondness between the hound and its master. There is only a common appreciation of the hunt.

quotes.name: Raise the Alarm
quotes.flavor: "The nim raid our homes without warning. We must defend our homes without hesitation."

quotes.name: Buried Ruin
quotes.flavor: History has buried its treasures deep.

quotes.name: Brineborn Cutthroat
quotes.flavor: "I always attack from where their spyglasses can't see."

quotes.name: Moat
quotes.flavor: The purpose of any moat is to impede attack. Some are filled with water, some with thistles. Some are filled with things best left unseen.

quotes.name: Echoing Deeps
quotes.flavor: The still, silent waters reflect what was, not what is.

quotes.name: Remorseful Cleric
quotes.flavor: A lifetime of keeping up appearances is not enough to earn an eternity of rest.

quotes.name: Talisman of Hierarchy
quotes.flavor:
"You'll never get to the top if you don't know who's already there."
—Kaya

quotes.name: Phyrexian Arena
quotes.flavor: The gladiatorial stadiums on New Phyrexia echo day and night with the sounds of grinding metal and tearing flesh.

quotes.name: Karmic Guide
quotes.flavor: Just one moment more

quotes.name: Rummaging Goblin
quotes.flavor: Goblins' eager curiosity leads them to scavenging, petty theft, and the rigging of sleek pirate ships. Some stop at scavenging.

quotes.name: Rampaging Baloths
quotes.flavor:
"When the land is angry, so are they."
—Nissa Revane

quotes.name: Serra Angel
quotes.flavor: Her sword sings more beautifully than any choir.

quotes.name: Incremental Blight
quotes.flavor: Shadowmoor's main crops are rot, slime, and despair.

quotes.name: Secure the Scene
quotes.flavor:
"You know it's a great show when the Azorius arrest the props, too!"
—Judith, the Scourge Diva

quotes.name: Rattleback Apothecary
quotes.flavor: "Looking for a little liquid courage? I also stock liquid murder, if that's what you're after."

quotes.name: Flying Men
quotes.flavor: Saffiyah clapped her hands and twenty flying men appeared at her side, each well trained in the art of combat.

quotes.name: Make a Stand
quotes.flavor: For a moment they stood tall, all fear forgotten.

quotes.name: Shroofus Sproutsire
quotes.flavor: His laughter—and everything else about him—was infectious.

quotes.name: Paranormal Analyst
quotes.flavor: "If I've done this right, it should immobilize all spirits in the area. If I've done this wrong... you know what, let's just hope I did it right."

quotes.name: Arcane Signet
quotes.flavor: As part of their indoctrination and training, a psyker learns to focus their mental strength through a psycho-reactive staff.

quotes.name: Azra Oddsmaker
quotes.flavor: "I never give odds on my own fights. Unless, of course, you want to bet *against* me . . ."

quotes.name: Lively Dirge
quotes.flavor: "Now rip your partner from the grave, and form an undead killing wave!"

quotes.name: Dormant Grove // Gnarled Grovestrider
quotes.flavor: As the natural cycle of day and night grew twisted, old powers stirred deep in the Ulvenwald.

quotes.name: Hornbash Mentor
quotes.flavor: "We share the same nuanced opinion of hunters and military goons: smash them."

quotes.name: Return to Dust
quotes.flavor: Some timelines forever fray, branch, and intermingle. Others end abruptly.

quotes.name: Giant Cockroach
quotes.flavor: Toren had stepped on a lot of bugs during his life, so he couldn't help feeling embarrassed when a bug stepped on him.

quotes.name: Nirkana Assassin
quotes.flavor: Nirkana assassins craft incurable concoctions by mixing basilisk marrow and deathwillow sap with the vital fluids of a dozen other poisonous species.

quotes.name: Flatman
quotes.flavor: "Name's Flatman. I'm the deputy leader of the Great Lakes Avengers! And I need answers!"

quotes.name: Acidic Slime
quotes.flavor: It fears no sword and leaves no bones behind.

quotes.name: Ixalan's Binding
quotes.flavor: Jace awoke to the certainty that he was lost.

quotes.name: Victual Sliver
quotes.flavor: "We are kinfolk," explained Karn to the sliver queen. "Just as you need your progeny to complete you, so do I need the pieces of the Legacy to make me whole."

quotes.name: Phyrexian Hulk
quotes.flavor:
"They are convenient in having no souls, but less so in having no spirit."
—Volrath

quotes.name: Borderland Behemoth
quotes.flavor: Giants share nothing but their fury.

quotes.name: Mossfire Valley
quotes.flavor: Lush growth spreads like a ferocious blaze across the Otarian hillsides.

quotes.name: Faith of the Devoted
quotes.flavor:
"The more I see of this place, the less I want to."
—Chandra Nalaar

quotes.name: Azami, Lady of Scrolls
quotes.flavor:
"Choices belong to those with the luxuries of time and distance. We have neither. I recommend we proceed with the plan to destroy all shrines of the kami."
—Lady Azami, letter to Sensei Hisoka

quotes.name: Axebane Guardian
quotes.flavor: Only a worthy few are permitted within the sentient forest known as Axebane.

quotes.name: Animating Faerie // Bring to Life
quotes.flavor: A true puppet master has no need for strings.

quotes.name: Lifesmith
quotes.flavor: The Sylvok see the artificer as a gardener, preparing the world for hardy growth.

quotes.name: Izzet Signet
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.

quotes.name: Casey Jones, Vigilante
quotes.flavor: "I'll teach you criminals to befoul our sewers!"

quotes.name: Halo Hopper
quotes.flavor: Folded by an imaginative child, animated by a mischievous kami, and blessed by an otherworldly angel.

quotes.name: Simic Signet
quotes.flavor: For the Simic Combine, its sigil serves not as an emblem of honor but as a trademark. Its familiar image on any biological commodity attests to superb craftsmanship, ingenious innovation, and higher cost.

quotes.name: Nature's Claim
quotes.flavor:
"The timeless, tireless jaws of nature shall one day devour us all."
—Sildark, artificer of Omu

quotes.name: The Elderspell
quotes.flavor: The path to power is often paved with atrocities.

quotes.name: Lord of Atlantis
quotes.flavor: A master of tactics, the Lord of Atlantis makes his people bold in battle merely by arriving to lead them.

quotes.name: Azami, Lady of Scrolls
quotes.flavor:
"Choices belong to those with the luxuries of time and distance. We have neither. I recommend we proceed with the plan to destroy all shrines of the kami."
—Lady Azami, letter to Sensei Hisoka

quotes.name: Savage Twister
quotes.flavor:
"Nature is the ultimate mindless destroyer, capable of power and ferocity no army can match, and the Gruul follow its example."
—Trigori, Azorius senator

quotes.name: Temporal Trespass
quotes.flavor: Few truly live in the moment.

quotes.name: Lórien Revealed
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"Look on us now with friendly eyes! Behold the trees of the Naith of Lórien and be glad!"
—Haldir

quotes.name: Mischievous Poltergeist
quotes.flavor:
"The past is a ghost that haunts you from the moment it exists until the moment you don't."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

quotes.name: Gluttonous Slime
quotes.flavor: On Jund, everything eventually ends up in something else's stomach.

quotes.name: Buy Your Silence
quotes.flavor: Mikey "the Mouth" kept his nickname after he struck his deal with Gregorio, even though he never spoke another word.

quotes.name: Akki Ember-Keeper
quotes.flavor: "Follow my lantern, little ones."

quotes.name: Sanctimony
quotes.flavor: "The peasants labor for my profit. I approve."

quotes.name: Cut of the Profits
quotes.flavor: Everybody is worth their weight in gold.

quotes.name: Air Elemental
quotes.flavor: These spirits of the air are winsome and wild and cannot be truly contained. Only marginally intelligent, they often substitute whimsy for strategy, delighting in mischief and mayhem.

quotes.name: Knight of Wundagore
quotes.flavor:
"Well struck, Lord Gator! Let our atomic steeds carry us to victory!"
—Lord Tyger

quotes.name: Seat of the Synod
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Mirrodin Pure vs. New Phyrexia
quotes.flavor: Lumengrid, site of the Knowledge Pool, source of vedalken arcana.

quotes.name: Cephalid Constable
quotes.flavor: Cephalids don't police people. They police loyalties.

quotes.name: Arrows of Justice
quotes.flavor: Archers from the Horizon Military Academy hone their skills by targeting pickpockets blocks away.

quotes.name: Cultivate
quotes.flavor: Hand in hand, they sowed the seeds, and the battered earth began to flourish once again.

quotes.name: Blinding Angel
quotes.flavor:
"It's turning out the lights!"
—Sally Sparrow

quotes.name: Brainstorm
quotes.flavor: "I hate to pull rank, but I was once Mystra's Chosen."

quotes.name: Floral Evoker
quotes.flavor: "Death is a natural thing. It replenishes the land's energy and nourishes the growth of all life."

quotes.name: Horizon Canopy
quotes.flavor: It was popularly believed, as local legend, that the Hill at Bag End was full of tunnels stuffed with treasure.

quotes.name: Selvala, Explorer Returned
quotes.flavor: "The Lowlands refuse to suffer at the whims of the High City."

quotes.name: Deadly Rollick
quotes.flavor: "Anyone can make their audience beg for an encore . . . I prefer mine to beg for mercy!"

quotes.name: Jodah, Archmage Eternal
quotes.flavor:
"Chronicles across the ages describe Jodah. They likely refer not to one mage, but to a family or an arcane title."
—Arkol, Argivian scholar

quotes.name: Rishadan Pawnshop
quotes.flavor: Everything comes to the waterfront eventually, on the tide or on credit.

quotes.name: Marrow-Gnawer
quotes.flavor: Marrow-Gnawer united three nezumi gangs when he slew their leaders in a single night. Now they call him their first lord.

quotes.name: Llanowar Elves
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Elves vs. Goblins
quotes.flavor:
One bone broken for every twig snapped underfoot.
—Llanowar penalty for trespassing

quotes.name: Raised by Giants
quotes.flavor: Your parents taught you that strength can be nurtured and honed, no matter one's size.

quotes.name: Duh
quotes.flavor:
Will players understand that the creature is being crushed by two parentheses?
Not a chance.

quotes.name: Bloodhunter Bat
quotes.flavor: It returns eager to share the feast of blood and gore with its ghoulish master.

quotes.name: Tempered Veteran
quotes.flavor: "I've been carrying a sword since before you were born. I wouldn't give up my oath for all the peace and comfort in the world."

quotes.name: Blazing Archon
quotes.flavor:
"Through the haze of battle I saw the glint of sun on golden mane, the sheen of glory clad in mail, and I dropped my sword and wept at the idiocy of war."
—Dravin, Gruul deserter

quotes.name: Ferrous Lake
quotes.flavor: Even before it was a super mutant camp, the water treatment plant was used for all sorts of questionable experiments.

quotes.name: Eriette of the Charmed Apple
quotes.flavor: "Hush now. I need your beauty sleep."

quotes.name: Dark Deed
quotes.flavor:
"With but a wave of my hand I shall destroy you forever!"
—Doctor Doom

quotes.name: Mangara of Corondor
quotes.flavor: "I have been brought to this place and I cannot leave. I may be free of the amber, but I am still in prison."

quotes.name: Fatespinner
quotes.flavor: No one knows what she is watching, but she never takes her eyes off it.

quotes.name: Nest Invader
quotes.flavor: It nurtures its masters' glorious future.

quotes.name: Ash Barrens
quotes.flavor:
"You should have granted us an audience. Instead, you now reign over a kingdom of ruins."
—Sarkhan, the Dragonspeaker

quotes.name: Toils of Night and Day
quotes.flavor:
"The war sent Kamigawa into turmoil. Here it was spring and there winter. For some, time stood still, while for others, moments flashed past like minnows in a pond."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

quotes.name: Brindle Shoat
quotes.flavor: Hunters lure the stripling boar into the open, hoping to trap greater prey.

quotes.name: Armored Galleon
quotes.flavor:
"Information equals profits. Our merchants sell it, or our pirates use it."
—Jefan, Talas ship captain

quotes.name: Crashing Boars
quotes.flavor: Bores ruin a party. Boars are party to ruin.

quotes.name: Tramway Station
quotes.flavor: A ten-minute ride can take you to the luxury of Park Heights, or the grit of the Caldaia.

quotes.name: Relentless Pursuit
quotes.flavor: Calix was patient, steadily following Elspeth until their destined confrontation.

quotes.name: Tributary Vaulter
quotes.flavor: "Other species may spread across the land all they like, but the riverways and the skies above them will always be ours."

quotes.name: Light the Way
quotes.flavor: "That way lies death. This way, a chance."

quotes.name: Crimson Cowl, Master of Evil
quotes.flavor: "My Masters of Evil is a *for-profit* organization, not a vendetta."

quotes.name: Cultivate
quotes.flavor: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

quotes.name: Viscerid Armor
quotes.flavor: A fallen Viscerid's only tribute is to be worn by a comrade.

quotes.name: Cold-Eyed Selkie
quotes.flavor: She follows the old tributaries built when merrows still shaped the tides.

quotes.name: Mogg Raider
quotes.flavor: The evisceration of one mogg always cheers up the rest.

quotes.name: Undertaker
quotes.flavor: The weight of death is heavy but not immovable.

quotes.name: Drop Tower
quotes.flavor: Sixty stories above the Astrotorium, attendees often wonder if they've made a mistake. They have another two hundred stories to decide.

quotes.name: Furious Strength
quotes.flavor:
"Time for my closing argument!"
—She-Hulk, Jennifer Walters

quotes.name: Bring Low
quotes.flavor:
"People are often humbled by the elements. But the elements, too, can be humbled."
—Surrak, khan of the Temur

quotes.name: Mosquito Guard
quotes.flavor: His aim is as sure as a mosquito's sting, but with none of the warning.

quotes.name: Mentor of the Meek
quotes.flavor: "In these halls there is no pass or fail. Your true test comes with the first full moon."

quotes.name: Jennika's Technique
quotes.flavor: "Of course it's dangerous. That's the whole point of a weapon!"

quotes.name: Illusionary Servant
quotes.flavor:
"Illusion is a handy but fragile medium. Use it only in a pinch, or against the dim-witted."
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Compulsive Research
quotes.flavor: "Four parts molten bronze, yes ... one part frozen mercury, yes, yes ... but then what?"

quotes.name: Rapid Hybridization
quotes.flavor: It's like the cycle of reincarnation, just significantly more abrupt.

quotes.name: Protection Magic
quotes.flavor: "Armor of light, halt physical might!"

quotes.name: Nim Shrieker
quotes.flavor: As imps they were an annoyance. As nim they are a pestilence.

quotes.name: Flooded Grove
quotes.flavor: At full moon, the river seeps over its banks and crawls through the woods like a blanket of serpents.

quotes.name: Sacred Peaks
quotes.flavor: Everyone is welcome in the floating Serran cities, though few but the most faithful attempt the ascent.

quotes.name: Grim Hireling
quotes.flavor: "This calls for a little redistribution of wealth."

quotes.name: Demonic Counsel
quotes.flavor: Valgavoth whispered into Marina's ear until he was all she could hear.

quotes.name: Symbiotic Wurm
quotes.flavor: The insects keep the wurm's hide free from parasites. In return, the wurm doesn't eat the insects.

quotes.name: Stensia Uprising
quotes.flavor: "Vampires have done nothing but take from us. Tonight, we reclaim what's ours!"

quotes.name: Invigorating Boon
quotes.flavor:
"Bright spores coalesced in empty air. Seedlings burst through barren soil. Genesis had arrived."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

quotes.name: Shuko
quotes.flavor:
"One scratch on a wall meant safe passage, two that the target had already been raided, and three warned of a trap."
—*Weaponry of Kamigawa*

quotes.name: One with the Machine
quotes.flavor:
"When I grafted the Planar Bridge into myself, I felt my Planeswalker spark flare beyond my body. The Multiverse was my plaything. It felt . . . incredible."
—Tezzeret

quotes.name: Thassa's Bounty
quotes.flavor:
"Was this gift cast adrift for any to find, or did Thassa guide the currents to bring it to me alone?"
—Kenessos, priest of Thassa

quotes.name: Steelshaper's Gift
quotes.flavor: "People say, 'Oh, it's dangerous to keep weapons in the home or the workplace.' Well, I say it's better to be hurt by someone you know accidentally than by a stranger on purpose."

quotes.name: Angelic Gift
quotes.flavor: "Zendikar will triumph this day, and our armies will fly with angels."

quotes.name: Multiply by Zero
quotes.flavor: Existence can be categorically denied. You just need the right variables.

quotes.name: Altar of Dementia
quotes.flavor:
"It is not that you will go mad. It is that you will beg for madness."
—Volrath

quotes.name: Hex
quotes.flavor: When killing five just isn't enough.

quotes.name: Grim Bounty
quotes.flavor: The Dusk Legion demanded a share of the gold. The pirates happily obliged.

quotes.name: Aerith, Last Ancient
quotes.flavor: "Right here, right now, I need to know I did everything I could."

quotes.name: Rakdos Signet
quotes.flavor: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

quotes.name: Eternal Taskmaster
quotes.flavor:
"They are called Eternals. They will never stop."
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Return to Nature
quotes.flavor:
"Even steel and stone return to Ghrin-Danu in time."
—Katilda, Dawnhart Prime

quotes.name: Scroll Thief
quotes.flavor: The arcane academies along the coast were powerless to protect themselves from the brazen raiders of the Kapsho Seas.

quotes.name: Jetmir's Garden
quotes.flavor: The parklike Cabaretti grounds offer rest, food, and the perfect place to shake off a tail.

quotes.name: Gravecrawler
quotes.flavor:
"Innistrad's ghoulcallers are talented enough, but let me show you what someone with real power can create."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Simic Signet
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor: For the Simic Combine, its sigil serves not as an emblem of honor but as a trademark. Its familiar image on any biological commodity attests to superb craftsmanship, ingenious innovation, and higher cost.

quotes.name: Hurloon Minotaur
quotes.flavor: The Minotaurs of the Hurloon Mountains are known for their love of battle. They are also known for their hymns to the dead, sung for friend and foe alike. These hymns can last for days, filling the mountain valleys with their low, haunting sounds.

quotes.name: Shimmer Myr
quotes.flavor: It evades Phyrexians by hiding in the spaces between seconds.

quotes.name: Civic Wayfinder
quotes.flavor: "These alleys are not safe. Come, I can guide you back to the market square."

quotes.name: Raise the Alarm
quotes.flavor: "The nim raid our homes without warning. We must defend our homes without hesitation."

quotes.name: Structural Assault
quotes.flavor: After the attack on the Vantoleone, the fragile balance of power shattered completely, and the city descended into chaos.

quotes.name: Cragganwick Cremator
quotes.flavor: Each night that his bowl fills, a village mourns.

quotes.name: Submerged Boneyard
quotes.flavor:
"Long after the land has given up the last of its secrets, there will still be mysteries in the depths of the sea."
—Kiora

quotes.name: Whispersilk Cloak
quotes.flavor:
"Creatures of stone, hearts of rock, give my enemies a terrible shock!"
—Shadow Weaver

quotes.name: Vampiric Tutor
quotes.flavor:
"I write upon clean white parchment with a sharp quill and the blood of my students, divining their secrets."
—Shauku, Endbringer

quotes.name: Morbid Opportunist
quotes.flavor: "It's downright selfish to die with full pockets."

quotes.name: Dragon Throne of Tarkir
quotes.flavor: What once soared high above Tarkir is now reduced to a seat.

quotes.name: Impulse
quotes.flavor: "You call it luck. I call it preparation."

quotes.name: Heroic Reinforcements
quotes.flavor: Cries of anguish quickly spurred cries of action.

quotes.name: Welcoming Vampire
quotes.flavor: From the moment they arrived, wedding guests were met with a pageant of wealth and excess.

quotes.name: Razorjaw Oni
quotes.flavor: It gnashed its teeth, and the battlefield filled with the screech of blade striking blade.

quotes.name: Kor Duelist
quotes.flavor: "Swords cannot reach far enough. Chains cannot strike hard enough. An eternal dilemma, but a simple one."

quotes.name: Order of the Ebon Hand
quotes.flavor: Dedicated to the principles of Tourach, members of the Order of the Ebon Hand demonstrated their devotion with grisly rituals.

quotes.name: Boros Signet
quotes.flavor:
"Have you ever held a Boros signet? There's a weight to it that belies its size—a weight of strength and of pride."
—Agrus Kos

quotes.name: Thriving Grove
quotes.flavor: Far from human eyes, birds flit between vivid blossoms in a hidden paradise.

quotes.name: Raubahn, Bull of Ala Mhigo
quotes.flavor: "Come, then! Who will be next to die on my steel!?"

quotes.name: Hill Giant
quotes.flavor: Fortunately, Hill Giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.

quotes.name: Aether Spellbomb
quotes.flavor:
"Release that which was never caged."
—Spellbomb inscription

quotes.name: Wall of Corpses
quotes.flavor:
"I shall make walls of their flesh, and their blood will be my mortar."
—Kaervek

quotes.name: Rod of Ruin
quotes.flavor: The rod is a relic from ancient times . . . cruel, vicious, mean-spirited times.

quotes.name: Boldwyr Intimidator
quotes.flavor: "Now everyone knows what you are."

quotes.name: Reclamation Sage
quotes.flavor: "What was once formed by masons, shaped by smiths, or given life by mages, I will return to the embrace of the earth."

quotes.name: Collar the Culprit
quotes.flavor:
"Reports of Gruul rioters in four districts. Start with the big ones and work your way up."
—Libuse, Boros sergeant

quotes.name: Frost Lynx
quotes.flavor: It readily attacks much larger prey, knowing retaliation is impossible.

quotes.name: Combat Medic
quotes.flavor:
"Although Icatia's Combat Medics borrowed much of their knowledge from other societies, their skills were their own."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. VI*

quotes.name: Word of Seizing
quotes.flavor: "Obey!"

quotes.name: Reclusive Taxidermist
quotes.flavor: All druids seek to preserve nature, but some go about it in rather unusual ways.

quotes.name: Diabolic Intent
quotes.flavor: Gix pierced his disciples' minds and savored their experiences as he took in their knowledge.

quotes.name: Rewards of Diversity
quotes.flavor:
"Everything is in place. Nothing can happen that isn't part of my plan."
—Urza

quotes.name: Druid's Call
quotes.flavor: Suffer the little creatures, for they may yet rise up and beat you senseless.

quotes.name: Igneous Inspiration
quotes.flavor: Prismari fosters a burning need to create.

quotes.name: Seachrome Coast
quotes.flavor: Where indoctrination meets inquiry, currents roil restlessly beneath the surface.

quotes.name: Zaffai and the Tempests
quotes.flavor: "Leave everything on the stage and give them a performance they'll never forget."

quotes.name: Quest for the Goblin Lord
quotes.flavor: A shrine to unchecked desire.

quotes.name: Horseshoe Crab
quotes.flavor: In the final days before the disaster, all the crabs on Tolaria migrated from inlets, streams, and ponds back to the sea. No one took note.

quotes.name: Akroan Crusader
quotes.flavor: An Akroan soldier's worth is measured by the number of swords raised by his battle cry.

quotes.name: Chromatic Sphere
quotes.flavor:
"Let insight and energy be your guides."
—The Blind Seer, to Gerrard

quotes.name: Sanctum Custodian
quotes.flavor: Serra told them to guard Urza as he healed. Five years they stood.

quotes.name: Zombie Infestation
quotes.flavor: The nomads' funeral pyres are more practical than ceremonial.

quotes.name: Thought Monitor
quotes.flavor: It roams the skies over the Quicksilver Sea, alert for any hint of aberrant thought.

quotes.name: Annoyed Altisaur
quotes.flavor: It pairs a long neck with a short temper.

quotes.name: Ninth Bridge Patrol
quotes.flavor: The Consulate keeps watch at each of the eleven bridges to ensure that the market remains a haven for commerce, not for con artists.

quotes.name: Serra
quotes.flavor: Named for a benevolent goddess at birth, Serra fulfilled the prophecy of that goddess's coming. As a planeswalker, she embodies white mana and helps whole civilizations develop while both directly and indirectly inspiring countless individuals to be steadfast and strong in the service of light.

quotes.name: Killian's Confidence
quotes.flavor: "Don't hold back, because I certainly won't."

quotes.name: Protean Raider
quotes.flavor: Imitation is the sincerest form of piracy.

quotes.name: Wooded Foothills
quotes.flavor: Home and hunting ground for Kaldheim's fearsome trolls.

quotes.name: Rogue Elephant
quotes.flavor:
"When are trees like grass?"
—*The One Thousand Questions*

quotes.name: Seal of Fire
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Jace vs. Chandra
quotes.flavor: After the fourth time Chandra left a place engulfed in flames, she decided to just go ahead and make it her thing.

quotes.name: Caught in the Brights
quotes.flavor: While hunting aether, a gremlin may ignore other stimuli, including threats to its own life.

quotes.name: Squall
quotes.flavor:
"To-night the winds begin to rise . . . The rooks are blown about the skies . . . ."
—Alfred, Lord Tennyson, *In Memoriam*

quotes.name: Tragic Arrogance
quotes.flavor: The spear thrown by Kytheon's own hand was the weapon that felled his friends.

quotes.name: Drana, Kalastria Bloodchief
quotes.flavor: "If our former masters would have us kneel again, they shall feel our defiance slashed across their membranes."

quotes.name: Drag Down
quotes.flavor: The barbarians of Jund believe the bottomless tar pits extend forever into other, darker worlds.

quotes.name: Pair o' Dice Lost
quotes.flavor: The Astrotorium is a zero-waste facility, meaning it deals with zero of its waste.

quotes.name: Invasion of Xerex // Vertex Paladin
quotes.flavor: The literal-minded Phyrexians made the greatest mistake possible on Xerex: they tried to understand what they were seeing.

quotes.name: Blue Sun's Zenith
quotes.flavor:
「五つの太陽よ！軌道計算がどんなに複雑か想像できる？そんな方程式に挑戦できるというなら、何だって差し出すわ！」
——クアンドリクスの魔導生徒、ジモーン

quotes.name: Balduvian Rage
quotes.flavor:
"Let your heartbeat be the thunder in the valley. Let your swords be the lightning on the peaks."
—Lothar Lovisason, Balduvian chieftain

quotes.name: Duress
quotes.flavor: "Change your mind, or I'll change it for you."

quotes.name: Plagiarize
quotes.flavor: "Are you thinking what I'm thinking?"

quotes.name: Dromoka's Gift
quotes.flavor: The simplest gift from a dragon can be a revered accolade for a human warrior.

quotes.name: Lord of the Accursed
quotes.flavor: The Curse of Wandering leaves only hatred.

quotes.name: Minamo, School at Water's Edge
quotes.flavor: Beyond, in the great fief of Belfalas, dwelt Prince Imrahil in his castle of Dol Amroth by the sea.

quotes.name: Hoard-Smelter Dragon
quotes.flavor: He collects the precious metals, and then converts the rest to propellant.

quotes.name: Wasp of the Bitter End
quotes.flavor: As the Second Sun glided into its final position in the sky, a chorus of wings sounded to herald the return of Nicol Bolas.

quotes.name: Maximus, Knight Apparent
quotes.flavor: "It is a knight's duty to better this fallen world."

quotes.name: Phyrexian Tower
quotes.flavor:
"Yawgmoth is dead, and his citadels lie empty. But there will always be some who seek power at any price."
—Karn

quotes.name: Muraganda Raceway
quotes.flavor: Stage 3: The steaming jungles of Muraganda under falling skies.

quotes.name: Cephalid Looter
quotes.flavor: "Amazing, isn't it, what humans will throw away when they're drowning?"

quotes.name: Mossfire Valley
quotes.flavor: The battle at Ganzan Pass left the land so saturated with blood and twisted kami magic that it was a century before a single blade of grass could take root.

quotes.name: Vega, the Watcher
quotes.flavor: One eye sees the past, one the present, and one the future—and none can be deceived.

quotes.name: Bond of Revival
quotes.flavor: "Today we throw off the yoke of death. Either this is an affirmation of the eternal cyclical nature of life, or it's just hilarious—depends on which of us you ask."

quotes.name: Howling Mine
quotes.flavor: Legend has it that the mine howls out the last words of those who died inside.

quotes.name: Rhox Bodyguard
quotes.flavor: An enlightened soul caged in a body made for battle.

quotes.name: Shineshadow Snarl
quotes.flavor: A flickering beacon of righteous corruption.

quotes.name: Fresh Meat
quotes.flavor: A scavenger's favorite appetizer is death.

quotes.name: Split Up
quotes.flavor:
"Don't be a wimp. We'll cover more ground this way."
—Rian, former survivor

quotes.name: Phyrexian Snowcrusher
quotes.flavor: Its plow wasn't designed for snow, but to carve a path through shrieking armies.

quotes.name: Gravel-Hide Goblin
quotes.flavor:
"No peace accord will save Ravnica. You don't build on rot. You burn it down and start again."
—Domri Rade

quotes.name: Master of Etherium
quotes.flavor: "Only a mind unfettered with the concerns of the flesh can see the world as it truly is."

quotes.name: Cathars' Crusade
quotes.flavor: Avacyn's holy warriors kept hope alive in her darkest hours. Now they will carry that hope across Innistrad.

quotes.name: Dread Statuary
quotes.flavor: The last reliable landmark in Tazeem just walked away.

quotes.name: Goblin Goon
quotes.flavor: Giant-sized body. Goblin-sized brain.

quotes.name: Armored Scrapgorger
quotes.flavor: "Eat. Sort. Eat. Sort. Eat."

quotes.name: Cryptic Caves
quotes.flavor: Only when you've given up the search will the caves yield their secrets.

quotes.name: Bonescythe Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"Their appendages are sharper than our swords and quicker than our bows."
—Hastric, Thunian scout

quotes.name: Dromoka Captain
quotes.flavor: "We fight not out of fear, but for honor."

quotes.name: Tolarian Terror
quotes.flavor: Afterward, a number of treatises on sea serpent morphology were swiftly revised.

quotes.name: Ghost Quarter
quotes.flavor: Where wasted life cries out to be reborn.

quotes.name: Icatian Infantry
quotes.flavor: The Icatian army easily repelled early surprise attacks by the Orcs on border towns like Montford.

quotes.name: Bonds of Faith
quotes.flavor:
"What cannot be destroyed will be bound."
—Oath of Avacyn

quotes.name: Lotleth Troll
quotes.flavor: He lurks in the undercity, eager for the corpse haulers to unload their rotting cargo.

quotes.name: Thermo-Alchemist
quotes.flavor: "Madness can't touch a mind ignited by genius."

quotes.name: Valeria Richards, Precocious
quotes.flavor: "Daddy went and built a very bad machine and forgot to tell anyone. Guess who just found it?"

quotes.name: The Wondrous Wasp
quotes.flavor: "Don't overlook the little things."

quotes.name: Honor of the Pure
quotes.flavor: Juntos, los soldados eran como una espada dorada, cortando a los enemigos y dañando la oscuridad.

quotes.name: Volrath's Stronghold
quotes.flavor: The seed of a world's evil.

quotes.name: Elves of Deep Shadow
quotes.flavor: Cast out of the Conclave generations ago, these elves found a home in the corrupted districts of the Golgari.

quotes.name: Emeria Angel
quotes.flavor: When the earth shudders, the sky overflows.

quotes.name: Lurking Evil
quotes.flavor:
"Ash is our air, darkness our flesh."
—*Phyrexian Scriptures*

quotes.name: Sun Titan
quotes.flavor: "Rise with the sun, daughter of Erik."

quotes.name: Penregon Strongbull
quotes.flavor: His child-lifting act was second only to his cauldron-punting routine.

quotes.name: Gather the Townsfolk
quotes.flavor: In the memories of those they lost lies the strength needed to defend their city.

quotes.name: Little Bear
quotes.flavor: Even the littlest bears joined in important bear meetings and moonlit dances.

quotes.name: Garenbrig Carver // Shield's Might
quotes.flavor: Countless knights of Garenbrig owe their lives to his peerless craftsmanship.

quotes.name: Merfolk Looter
quotes.flavor: Merfolk don't always know what they're looking for, but they're certain once they find it.

quotes.name: Banishing Light
quotes.flavor:
The Champion reached for a stone, and Heliod placed the sun into her hand.
—*The Theriad*

quotes.name: Flare of Fortitude
quotes.flavor: "I call upon a power greater than myself."

quotes.name: Disperse
quotes.flavor: It's pointless to hold on when you have nothing to hold on with.

quotes.name: Hymn to Tourach
quotes.flavor:
"Tourach's power was such that his followers deified him after his death."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. II*

quotes.name: Villainous Ogre
quotes.flavor:
"The war saw the ogres emerge from their caves, reeking of blood, with the power of oni in their veins."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

quotes.name: Sigiled Starfish
quotes.flavor: Kruphix hid the most dire prophecies about humankind where humans would never find them and tritons wouldn't care to read them.

quotes.name: Hungry Flames
quotes.flavor: In the hold of the *Heart of Kiran*, Chandra answered Dovin Baan's sabotage with an explosive retort.

quotes.name: Mana Tithe
quotes.flavor:
"Those who seek to upset the balance must be taxed for such ambitions."
—Verithain, mesa high priest

quotes.name: Guul Draz Mucklord
quotes.flavor: Death comes in many forms on Guul Draz, most of them slow, subtle, and agonizing. At least a monstrous crocodile offers a swift death.

quotes.name: Demon of Loathing
quotes.flavor: Hatred is a potent ally, but an insatiable master.

quotes.name: Ogre Taskmaster
quotes.flavor: Three little goblins, enjoying their brew. One bumped an ogre, and then there were two.

quotes.name: Worldly Tutor
quotes.flavor:
"Aselbo soon had the rhino eating from his palm and the snake waiting at his heels."
—Afari, *Tales*

quotes.name: Tidal Wave
quotes.flavor:
"The floor of the sea is paved with the shattered remnants of vessels that navigated its surface unwelcomed."
—Thassa, god of the sea

quotes.name: Scorching Dragonfire
quotes.flavor: Kaito ran. Illusion or no, the fire felt hot enough to kill.

quotes.name: Ronin Cavekeeper
quotes.flavor: The akki were surprised to encounter a human who could fight in the caves as well as they.

quotes.name: Nettle Sentinel
quotes.flavor: Though Shadowmoor's monster-haunted wilds beckon, she never leaves her post.

quotes.name: Lifespring Druid
quotes.flavor: "The land is not dead, merely sick. I will nurse it back to health."

quotes.name: Reflect Damage
quotes.flavor:
From you to me, so me to you.
—Femeref children's taunt

quotes.name: Cerebral Vortex
quotes.flavor: Izzet brains and Izzet boilers: contents under pressure.

quotes.name: Simic Initiate
quotes.flavor: Simic initiates begin their training as experimental subjects. Failures are flushed to the undersewers.

quotes.name: Syr Alin, the Lion's Claw
quotes.flavor: "The realm must never yield to the chaos of the wilds."

quotes.name: Embereth Shieldbreaker // Battle Display
quotes.flavor: "Courage is the only shield I need."

quotes.name: Redtooth Genealogist
quotes.flavor: Some family trees are thornier than others.

quotes.name: Mavren Fein, Dusk Apostle
quotes.flavor: In the rapture of his Blood Fast, he destroyed the navigator's tools and steered the ship to shore by faith alone.

quotes.name: Liliana's Elite
quotes.flavor:
"You have to admit, Gideon—he has great form."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Ivory Tower
quotes.flavor: Valuing scholarship above all else, the inhabitants of the Ivory Tower reward those who sacrifice power for knowledge.

quotes.name: Wand of the Elements
quotes.flavor: It gives legs to the earth and wings to the sky.

quotes.name: Gods Willing
quotes.flavor: Honor the gods of Theros, and they will return the favor.

quotes.name: Clambassadors
quotes.flavor: "Sorry we shelled your village—here's some gold."

quotes.name: Watermarket
quotes.flavor:
Shopping List
Lamp-hand attachment
X-ray contact lenses
Discount death ray
Two-headed hammer
Kitten-fish

quotes.name: Fertile Ground
quotes.flavor: Fertile does not always mean safe.

quotes.name: Boiling Blood
quotes.flavor:
Your father has no horns!
Your mother wears a bell!
You drink the milk of goats!
—Talruum taunts

quotes.name: Mind Twist
quotes.flavor: The doubt expunged, the walls restored, memory molded like clay.

quotes.name: Mutagenic Growth
quotes.flavor:
"Sympathy is for weaklings. Whoever survives, wins."
—Benzir, archdruid of Temple Might

quotes.name: Sudden Shock
quotes.flavor: Arc mages aren't known for their patience.

quotes.name: Totally Lost
quotes.flavor: Fblthp had always hated crowds.

quotes.name: Dragon Engine
quotes.flavor:
"How is it the legged engines seem so much more alive than their wheeled counterparts? Simply, they were born, not made."
—Mishra

quotes.name: Fumigate
quotes.flavor: The one small garden of a free gardener was all Sam's need and due, not a garden swollen to a realm; his own hands to use, not the hands of others to command.

quotes.name: Horizon Seed
quotes.flavor: In peaceful times, these beings escorted the honored kami to their new shrines. In the Kami War, they became the medics of an unstoppable army.

quotes.name: Village Rites
quotes.flavor: "You were so eager to take and consume. Yet when asked to give, you refuse?"

quotes.name: Defender of Chaos
quotes.flavor: Some knights will not follow orders—only disorder.

quotes.name: Blood Crypt
quotes.flavor: Vampires invited to a soiree at Markov Manor are expected to bring a guest or refreshments—or both.

quotes.name: Privileged Position
quotes.flavor: There's no better defense than simply being out of reach.

quotes.name: Seasoned Marshal
quotes.flavor:
"We are not interested in the possibilities of defeat."
—Queen Victoria

quotes.name: Lady Orca
quotes.flavor:
"I do not remember what he said to her. I remember her fiery eyes, fixed upon him for an instant. I remember a flash, and the hot breath of sudden flames made me turn away. When I looked again, Angus was gone."
—A Wayfarer, on meeting Lady Orca

quotes.name: Altar's Reap
quotes.flavor:
"Don't worry, your death will be as informative as possible."
—Gorghul, augur of skulls

quotes.name: Ashes of the Fallen
quotes.flavor: The ashes of the dead mingle with the soil, and both become as one.

quotes.name: The Fire Crystal
quotes.flavor: "Warriors of Light...Only you can restore hope to the world, for yours is the light that can balance out the darkness..."

quotes.name: Frenzied Goblin
quotes.flavor: The upside to not thinking about the consequences is that you'll always surprise those who do.

quotes.name: Nimble Birdsticker
quotes.flavor: "What goes up must get stuck."

quotes.name: Crush Dissent
quotes.flavor:
"All I ask is complete obedience."
—Nicol Bolas

quotes.name: Rats of Rath
quotes.flavor:
"These creatures offer new challenges in the scrutiny of entrails."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

quotes.name: Rogue's Passage
quotes.flavor:
"Make your way out of town through the mines! I'll try to buy you some time."
-—Old man from Narshe

quotes.name: Tormod's Crypt
quotes.flavor: Dominaria's most extravagant crypt nevertheless holds an empty grave.

quotes.name: Fire Ambush
quotes.flavor: "With fire he broke the battle at Bowang . . . . Striking fear deep into Cao Cao's soul, thus Kongming scored a coup at his debut."

quotes.name: Blanchwood Armor
quotes.flavor:
"There's never been a dwarven smith who could match the marvels that Gaea herself forges."
—Elvish champion

quotes.name: Swiftfoot Boots
quotes.flavor:
"There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared."
—Kenjek, captain of the Thousand Swords

quotes.name: Urban Evolution
quotes.flavor: As the Simic released more of their krasis experiments, they required new habitats, always at the expense of the locals.

quotes.name: Super Shredder
quotes.flavor: "I have molded myself into perfection, Hamato. Look upon me, and know fear."

quotes.name: Kadena, Slinking Sorcerer
quotes.flavor: "The only constant in life is the unknown."

quotes.name: Wild Griffin
quotes.flavor: Farmers typically keep their flocks at thirteen sheep—one to distract the griffins while they take the other twelve to market.

quotes.name: Isolated Chapel
quotes.flavor: Serra's blessing lies strongest upon Sursi, where her holy chapels are untouched even as evil encroaches.

quotes.name: Faerie Guidemother // Gift of the Fae
quotes.flavor: No one is so lost that a faerie can't find them.

quotes.name: Madame Hydra
quotes.flavor: "This will be our night of glory! Hail HYDRA!"

quotes.name: Hobblefiend
quotes.flavor: Bedbugs aren't the only things you need to worry about biting you at night.

quotes.name: Drowned Catacomb
quotes.flavor:
"Make no mistake, the rats run these tunnels. We just live here."
—Fiends gang member

quotes.name: Ass Whuppin'
quotes.flavor: Asses to ashes, Donkeys to dust.

quotes.name: Tavern Swindler
quotes.flavor: Rakdos cultists are her best customers. They never flinch at pain and are seldom good at math.

quotes.name: Army of Allah
quotes.flavor: On the day of victory no one is tired. —Arab proverb

quotes.name: Quirion Dryad
quotes.flavor:
"Never underestimate the ability of natural forces to adapt to unnatural influences."
—Molimo, maro-sorcerer

quotes.name: Dragonsguard Elite
quotes.flavor: "The Founder Dragons brought the Blood Age to an end. It is an honor to serve them."

quotes.name: Spectral Flight
quotes.flavor:
"The church looks down on binding spirits into armor, but now I can look down on them."
—Dierk, geistmage

quotes.name: Viridescent Bog
quotes.flavor: The Master had literally built his army one mutant at a time. Humans, preferably with little radiation damage, were captured and sent to the vats.

quotes.name: Aven Reedstalker
quotes.flavor: "Our best chance against the Eternals will be tactics they've never seen and styles they've never trained in."

quotes.name: Rushwood Dryad
quotes.flavor: To a dryad, every tree in the forest is both a doorway and a window.

quotes.name: Treeshaker Chimera
quotes.flavor: The wisdom of the past is written on the bones of ancients.

quotes.name: Ghoulcaller's Accomplice
quotes.flavor: "Once in the box, we're all the same."

quotes.name: Lightstall Inquisitor
quotes.flavor: Born of dead stars, the Astelli may fight for light, but they know the void as their womb.

quotes.name: Take Up the Shield
quotes.flavor: The frontier was an anvil on which many an unlikely hero would be forged.

quotes.name: Warhorn Blast
quotes.flavor: "Mead down! Swords up!"

quotes.name: Demon's Horn
quotes.flavor: Its curve mimics the twists of life and death.

quotes.name: Repulsive Mutation
quotes.flavor:
"Remind me to send the biomancer team a gift basket."
—Olana, Simic field researcher

quotes.name: Imperial Seal
quotes.flavor:
"Oh, for heaven's sake, of course it was a death threat! What did you think was in an envelope like that, a wedding invitation?"
—Magistrate's assistant

quotes.name: Slaughter Specialist
quotes.flavor: From every kill, a gruesome trophy.

quotes.name: Soul Warden
quotes.flavor:
Count carefully the souls and see that none are lost.
—Vec teaching

quotes.name: Cogwork Assembler
quotes.flavor: Duplication is neither thievery nor flattery. It is efficiency.

quotes.name: MJ, Rising Star
quotes.flavor: "Will they? Won't they? Find out next time, on the season finale of *Secret Hospital.*"

quotes.name: Evacuation
quotes.flavor:
"Once I supply the breeze, you'll see your warriors for the smoke they truly are."
—Alexi, zephyr mage

quotes.name: Skybeast Tracker
quotes.flavor: Cloud eaters, heaven tillers, beanstalk wurms—he favors prey worthy of a giant's appetite.

quotes.name: Cecil, Dark Knight // Cecil, Redeemed Paladin
quotes.flavor: "This is my battle, one I must fight alone to atone for my wrongs."

quotes.name: Lunarch Mantle
quotes.flavor:
"A boon from the angels should never be cast aside."
—Manfried Ulmach, Chief Inquisitor

quotes.name: Vigilant Drake
quotes.flavor: It can stay aloft for weeks with little or no sleep.

quotes.name: Entangler
quotes.flavor: "Tell me again," said Latulla, raising her fist, "how just one woman held back an entire Keldon platoon."

quotes.name: Raptor Companion
quotes.flavor: A raptor will follow any order as long as that order is "hunt," "kill," or "go for the guts."

quotes.name: Arcane Sanctum
quotes.flavor: The Emperor is the greatest psyker in Human history. For thousands of years, he has sat immobile in a palace that spans a continent.

quotes.name: Shivan Gorge
quotes.flavor: Both forge and pyre.

quotes.name: Snowmelt Stag
quotes.flavor: Elementals conjured by Temur mages are forever watchful and swift.

quotes.name: Strangling Soot
quotes.flavor:
"What good is your blade without your breath?"
—Greht, Gathan warlord

quotes.name: Whisper of the Dross
quotes.flavor: "Live or die, you serve the Steel Thanes now."

quotes.name: Recumbent Bliss
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Ajani vs. Nicol Bolas
quotes.flavor: Kithkin somnomancers enjoy the peaceful dreams wafting from their victims.

quotes.name: Faerie Guidemother // Gift of the Fae
quotes.flavor: No one is so lost that a faerie can't find them.

quotes.name: View from Above
quotes.flavor: "This air feels so heavy and thick. There are no winds to speak of. I fear the knowledge that comes from a place like this."

quotes.name: Brass Squire
quotes.flavor:
"I admire it. Few pull off pluck and subservience at the same time."
—Ezuri, renegade leader

quotes.name: Urborg Syphon-Mage
quotes.flavor: "I have become a gourmet of sorts. Each soul has its own distinctive flavor. The art is in inviting the right company to the feast."

quotes.name: Fiery Inscription
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: Ash nazg durbatulûk, ash nazg gimbatul, ash nazg thrakatulûk agh burzum-ishi krimpatul.

quotes.name: Niv-Mizzet, the Firemind
quotes.flavor: As brilliant as a cut diamond, and with just as cruel an edge.

quotes.name: Noose Constrictor
quotes.flavor:
"More rope may not be necessary."
—Kep, Lunarch inquisitor

quotes.name: Sunweb
quotes.flavor: Sometimes the wings of fallen dragons refuse to give up the sky.

quotes.name: Temple of Triumph
quotes.flavor: All matches continue until one side is dead. No exceptions.

quotes.name: Teferi's Protege
quotes.flavor: Teferi's legacy lives on in Tolaria through the study of time magic and a tradition of irrepressible mischief.

quotes.name: Lord of Atlantis
quotes.flavor: A master of tactics, the lord of Atlantis makes his people bold in battle merely by arriving to lead them.

quotes.name: Time Reversal
quotes.flavor:
"Optimists see the world as they wish it to be. Pessimists see the world as it is. Must these roles be mutually exclusive?"
—Evo Ragus

quotes.name: Scathe Zombies
quotes.flavor:
"They groaned, they stirred, they all uprose,
Nor spake, nor moved their eyes;
It had been strange, even in a dream,
To have seen those dead men rise."
—Samuel Taylor Coleridge,
"The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

quotes.name: Boon of Safety
quotes.flavor:
"Saving a stranger's life is an excellent recruitment method. Luckily, peril is so easy to come by."
—Falco Spara

quotes.name: Natural Spring
quotes.flavor: The dying ask for water because they know it contains life.

quotes.name: Vicious Rumors
quotes.flavor:
"The alliances were already frayed. All we do is find the loose threads and pluck."
—Lazav

quotes.name: Skycloud Expanse
quotes.flavor: "How did we get up so high so quick?" asked Clara, "Clever staircase. It's taller on the inside," replied the Doctor.

quotes.name: Harried Spearguard
quotes.flavor: "Why're you vermin so daft? This is a warehouse full of bricks. BRICKS! You can't eat bricks."

quotes.name: Roaming Ghostlight
quotes.flavor: Some who die senseless deaths return as formless spirits, seeking answers where there are none.

quotes.name: Dauntless Cathar
quotes.flavor: "The harder they try to extinguish my faith, the brighter it burns in the darkness."

quotes.name: Carnivorous Death-Parrot
quotes.flavor: Save a kill spell to deal with this guy.

quotes.name: Chittering Rats
quotes.flavor: Bottom feeders sometimes rise to the top.

quotes.name: Changeling Wayfinder
quotes.flavor: No map. No complaints.

quotes.name: Unexpected Request
quotes.flavor: "I shall hereby do my best to kidnap you!"

quotes.name: Heroes' Bane
quotes.flavor: Travelers' tales claim that hydras bite off their own heads to make themselves deadlier.

quotes.name: Goblin War Drums
quotes.flavor: Their eardrums may have given out, but the rest of them never will.

quotes.name: Band Together
quotes.flavor: In times of peril, the vision the ancient paruns had for their city comes into focus.

quotes.name: Colossification
quotes.flavor:
"Turns out the case of the flattened outpost and the case of the missing kitten *were* related."
—Endris, Drannith magistrate

quotes.name: Lightning Bolt
quotes.flavor: The sparkmage shrieked, calling on the rage of the storms of his youth. To his surprise, the sky responded with a fierce energy he'd never thought to see again.

quotes.name: Goblin King
quotes.flavor: To be king, Numsgil did in Blog, who did in Unkful, who did in Viddle, who did in Loll, who did in Alrok. . . .

quotes.name: Eager Cadet
quotes.flavor: "Training? Seeing my crops burnt to cinders was all the 'training' I needed."

quotes.name: Neheb, the Eternal
quotes.flavor:
"This is what glory looks like."
—Nicol Bolas

quotes.name: Bile Blight
quotes.flavor:
"Hold your bitterness deep within, and there let it fester. Let it roil and squirm and churn, until you are filled with bile so poisonous that all you touch falls to ruin."
—Morarion, Daemon Primarch

quotes.name: True Believer
quotes.flavor: So great is his certainty that mere facts cannot shake it.

quotes.name: Aftermath Analyst
quotes.flavor: "Could someone bring me more evidence markers? Like . . . a lot more?"

quotes.name: Shivan Dragon
quotes.flavor: While it's true most Dragons are cruel, the Shivan Dragon seems to take particular glee in the misery of others, often tormenting its victims much like a cat plays with a mouse before delivering the final blow.

quotes.name: Rusted Slasher
quotes.flavor:
"It's a beautiful vision. Discarded debris is reborn as a singular entity."
—Urabrask the Hidden

quotes.name: Artillery Blast
quotes.flavor: To conserve ammunition, Jhoira modified ancient Thran artillery cannons to fire gouts of pure Shivan lava.

quotes.name: Thoughtseize
quotes.flavor:
Billy, please don't forget to add the headline before sending for publication again.
—Clara

quotes.name: Peter Parker // Amazing Spider-Man
quotes.flavor: ". . . and I couldn't wait to swing by."

quotes.name: Blasphemous Edict
quotes.flavor:
"A demonic pact is all fun and games until the bill comes due."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Juggernaut
quotes.flavor:
"Urza's machines have a splendid habit of excavating themselves."
—Rona, disciple of Gix

quotes.name: Coat of Arms
quotes.flavor: We love all shapes and sizes—the weirder, the better.

quotes.name: Costly Plunder
quotes.flavor: No lock of iron is a match for Vraska's will of stone.

quotes.name: Rampant Growth
quotes.flavor: All through the winter Sam remained as patient as he could. Spring surpassed his wildest hopes.

quotes.name: Arboria
quotes.flavor: As the world steeled itself for the New Phyrexian invasion, the heart of the Pinelands awoke, and a new maro-sorcerer strode forth to join the fight.

quotes.name: Roil Eruption
quotes.flavor:
"Our feeble villages and tiny encampments stand only at the whim of the Roil."
—*The Invokers' Tales*

quotes.name: Sol Ring
quotes.flavor: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

quotes.name: Vedalken Orrery
quotes.flavor:
"My observations of the Multiverse are too valuable not to preserve for posterity."
—Dovin Baan

quotes.name: Leering Onlooker
quotes.flavor: "Ooh, this one does look nasty. Maybe they'll send Proft!"

quotes.name: Siege Behemoth
quotes.flavor:
"Hold the line, hold the li—"
—General Srok, last words

quotes.name: Vow of Lightning
quotes.flavor:
"For all I have lost, for all who have fallen, I will render you to dust."
—Jared Carthalion
